description: This is a test file written in JavaScript using Mocha and Chai frameworks to test payload classes and functions such as DecryptedPayload, EncryptedPayload, DeletedPayload, and related methods.

classes.name: DecryptedPayload
classes.description: A class representing a decrypted payload with properties like uuid, content_type, content, source, created_at, updated_at, etc.

classes.name: EncryptedPayload
classes.description: A class representing an encrypted payload, handling encryption-specific logic and versioning.

classes.name: DeletedPayload
classes.description: A class representing a payload that has been marked as deleted.

methods.name: payload.copy
methods.description: Creates a new payload instance by copying existing payload and overriding given fields.

methods.name: isDecryptedPayload
methods.description: Type guard function to check if a payload is decrypted.

methods.name: isEncryptedPayload
methods.description: Type guard function to check if a payload is encrypted.

methods.name: isDeletedPayload
methods.description: Type guard function to check if a payload is deleted.

methods.description: Function returning an incremented dirty index, used for versioning.
